name: SuomiCraft PE
description:
SuomiCraft PE is a Finnish Minecraft Bedrock Edition server featuring various minigames and gamemodes.

We have on the server:

- Survival world with homes, land protection and economy shop

- Factions where griefing is allowed

- Creative plots

- Lots of parkour levels

- Kit PvP world with kit builder

- BedWars

- SkyWars

- TNTRun

- Spleef with shovels and snowballs

- ColorMatch single and multiplayer

- LuckyBlocks with over 100 unique surprises

- Special cosmetics for top voters

- Multiversion support: play using the version you like the most

And more is coming! Join our Discord server to stay up to date with the latest news: https://discord.gg/FBDFGFp6UJ
